title: Changing font size is not applied to System Tray until plasmashell is restarted
line: The System Tray popup now picks up a new font size right away instead of keeping the old one until plasmashell restarts.
explanation: Plasma's Kirigami theme plugin (PlasmaTheme in libplasma) copied the application font once when each theme object was created and never updated it, so everything using Kirigami.Theme.defaultFont (the tray heading, the clock, many applets) kept the old size. The tray's item labels and the TextMetrics that sizes the grid cells used no explicit font, so they fell back to Qt Quick's theme font, which Qt only re-propagates inside ApplicationWindow, not in Plasma's plain QQuickWindows. PlasmaTheme now listens for QEvent::ApplicationFontChange (one shared event filter) and updates defaultFont and smallFont, and the tray label and metrics bind to Kirigami.Theme.defaultFont, like qqc2-desktop-style's Label does.

commits.message:
kirigamiplasmastyle: update fonts when the application font changes

PlasmaTheme copied the application font once when it was created, so
Kirigami.Theme.defaultFont and smallFont kept the old size after a font
change until plasmashell restarted. Now they follow the app font.

BUG: 444629

applets/systemtray: follow font changes in the hidden items grid

Item labels and the text metrics that size the grid cells used Qt
Quick's fallback font, which isn't updated in Plasma's windows after a
font change. Use Kirigami.Theme.defaultFont so both update live.

BUG: 444629

patches.diff:
From 556eb6098a8c0368bd7375355043f4d2681797c4 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 14:22:52 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/systemtray: follow font changes in the hidden items
 grid

Item labels and the text metrics that size the grid cells used Qt
Quick's fallback font, which isn't updated in Plasma's windows after a
font change. Use Kirigami.Theme.defaultFont so both update live.

BUG: 444629
---
 applets/systemtray/qml/AbstractItem.qml    | 1 +
 applets/systemtray/qml/HiddenItemsView.qml | 1 +
 2 files changed, 2 insertions(+)

diff --git a/applets/systemtray/qml/AbstractItem.qml b/applets/systemtray/qml/AbstractItem.qml
index 007e62cc6d..47c25992e4 100644
--- a/applets/systemtray/qml/AbstractItem.qml
+++ b/applets/systemtray/qml/AbstractItem.qml
@@ -175,6 +175,7 @@ PlasmaCore.ToolTipArea {
             id: label
 
             Layout.fillWidth: true
+            font: Kirigami.Theme.defaultFont
             maximumLineCount: abstractItem.maxTextLines
 
             visible: abstractItem.inHiddenLayout
diff --git a/applets/systemtray/qml/HiddenItemsView.qml b/applets/systemtray/qml/HiddenItemsView.qml
index a7e6f967fd..d2fca1eeff 100644
--- a/applets/systemtray/qml/HiddenItemsView.qml
+++ b/applets/systemtray/qml/HiddenItemsView.qml
@@ -38,6 +38,7 @@ PlasmaComponents3.ScrollView {
 
         TextMetrics {
             id: metrics
+            font: Kirigami.Theme.defaultFont
             text: i18nc("Some letters with tall characters, ascenders, descenders, etc", "AILlmyjgGJP")
         }
 
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Before: General font changed 10pt -> 16pt and applied; the tray popup heading and items stay at 10pt (and the panel clock doesn't change)
After: same steps; heading, item labels and the grid (two-line cells) use 16pt right away, matching a restarted plasmashell
